I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Proof Reader and Copy Holder sound like specialist jobs, but their written test is the same general paper as PSSSB Clerk - with sharp Punjabi and English, you have an edge.

PSSSB Advertisement No. 04 of 2023 (95 posts) was published on 23 August 2023; applications ran from 28 August to 22 September 2023, fee by 25 September 2023. This page uses that advertisement and the board's final plan of written examination for Proof Reader and Copy Holder.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 04/2023 final plan - 2 hours 30 minutes on OMR. Part A is 50 matric-level Punjabi questions (qualifying, 25 marks needed, no negative marking). Part B has 100 general questions with 1/4 mark cut per wrong answer. Merit is made from Part B.

Is there a subject paper on proof reading?

No. Part B is a general paper - GK, Punjab history and culture, reasoning, Punjabi, English and ICT.

When was it last advertised?

In PSSSB Advertisement No. 04 of 2023. Its eligibility, pay and post numbers are on this page.
